# Kenney Tiny Dungeon

Five selected tiles from [Kenney Tiny Dungeon](https://kenney.nl/assets/tiny-dungeon) provide arena decoration: `tile_0000`, `tile_0001`, `tile_0002`, `tile_0016`, and `tile_0017`.

The source is recorded as CC0. This import has no separate bundled license file; retain the [license note](../../Licenses/Kenney_TinyDungeon_LICENSE_NOTE.md) and [asset license manifest](../../Licenses/ASSET_LICENSES.md).

Unused tiles belong in the [inactive archive](../../_Archive/README.md). Add only the assets needed for a specific scene change.
